description: Verify pregnancy gestation eligibility (12+ weeks) and optional slot availability, then generate a direct pre-selected booking URL on bumptobabysa.co.za where the parent confirms their slot (pay on arrival by card or cash).

date.description: Optional preferred appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format to pre-verify availability.

gestation_weeks.description: Optional gestational age in weeks (must be 12 or higher; 14+ weeks recommended for gender).

package_slug.description: Desired scan package code: "4d" (4D/5D HD-Live Scan R850), "gender" (Gender Reveal Scan R600), or "2d" (2D Reassurance Scan R500).

time.description: Optional preferred start time in 24-hour HH:MM format (e.g. "10:00").

name: prepare_booking_link
